test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

Practising math sums in **__so many__** periods over time is better than in long periods of time, for effective learning.
solution:
The correct answer is **"short"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"A short period"** is an idiom that shows a small amount of time.
 
• As "sums" is in the plural form hence, we need to use "periods" in a plural form.
 
• Look at some examples:
 
 
• I did that work for a **short period** of time.
 
• I played cricket for a **short period **of time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer will be:* Practising math sums in short__ periods over time is better than in long periods of time, for effective learning.*
